name: qwen3_vl_4b_instruct
rationale: Small dense Qwen3-VL model; best first target for a modern trend-aligned semantic-source adapter on a single 32GB GPU.

name: qwen2_5_vl_3b_instruct
rationale: Small Qwen2.5-VL model with mature official model card and Transformers examples; use if Qwen3-VL package/runtime friction blocks progress.

name: qwen3_vl_2b_instruct
rationale: Lowest-cost Qwen3-VL candidate for prompt/parser/runtime smoke tests; not the preferred paper-quality model unless 4B/8B are infeasible.

name: qwen3_vl_8b_instruct
rationale: Higher-quality small dense Qwen3-VL follow-up if 4B smoke passes and runtime budget allows.

name: qwen2_5_vl_7b_instruct
rationale: Stable Qwen2.5-VL quality follow-up; useful for checking whether observed gains depend on the Qwen3-VL family.
